# Command: create-project

## Prerequisites
- git-init has been run
- Java 17 is available

## Actions
Invoke skill: project-scaffold
- Create App.java with Hello World main class
- Create MathUtils.java with add() method
- Verify files exist after creation

## Expected files
- src/main/java/com/lab1/App.java
- src/main/java/com/lab1/MathUtils.java

## Verification command
dir src\main\java\com\lab1\

## Error message
"Failed to create project files. Check Java path and permissions."
